actions.text: Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words. I’m interested in this project — the scope (real-time charts, REST API integration, auth/roles, responsive + dark mode) is a good fit. A few quick questions so I can prepare a proposal: 1) Can you share API docs or an example payload and expected events-per-second / data volume for the real-time streams? 2) Do you have a preferred auth provider (OAuth/JWT/SAML) or should I propose an approach? 3) For charts, are you open to alternatives to D3 (e.g., Recharts, Visx) for faster development? 4) Do you have an existing design system or Figma files, or should I provide UI designs? 5) Who are the stakeholders and what’s the approval process? Based on what you sent, the $5k–$6k budget and ~4 week timeline are reasonable — I can prepare a detailed milestone-based proposal and timeline after I review the API and confirm requirements. I’m available for a 30-minute call to discuss details; here are some times I’m available next week (Central Time): Tue/Wed 10–12 or Thu 2–4. Let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite. Thanks — Jordan Mitchell (ML Engineer) • jordanmitchell.dev • linkedin.com/in/jordanmitchell
